patient_message: If you have chest pain or pressure right now, or it is severe or getting worse, please stop and call 000 (triple zero). Your care team has also been alerted.
rationale: Dataset: current or new chest pain suggestive of myocardial ischaemia needs urgent clinician assessment; emergency response if severe/ongoing. Spec ESC-001.

patient_message: If you are severely short of breath right now, or it is getting worse quickly, please call 000 (triple zero). Your care team has also been alerted.
rationale: Dataset: new or severe dyspnoea at rest or rapidly worsening breathlessness needs prompt clinician assessment. Spec ESC-001 lists severe dyspnoea.

patient_message: If you have severe swelling or pain in your abdomen, or you keep vomiting, right now, please get urgent medical help: call 000 (triple zero) or go to your nearest emergency department. Your care team has also been alerted.
rationale: Dataset: suspected active bowel obstruction needs prompt clinician/surgical assessment; treat as high aspiration risk.

Anaesthetic safety history (difficult airway, perioperative anaphylaxis, malignant hyperthermia, anaesthetic death in a relative). Dataset: mandatory clinician review; 'unsure' also escalates (MH: treat as potentially susceptible until clarified).
Limited mouth opening / neck movement: clinician airway review (dataset). Severity can't be judged from a yes/no, so any yes escalates.
Previous perioperative reaction or chlorhexidine reaction: mandatory clinician review and record retrieval (dataset); 'unsure' also escalates.

rationale: New or significant symptoms (deterioration, infection, respiratory infection, unexplained symptoms, syncope, palpitations, orthopnoea, PND, oedema, functional decline, wheeze, haemoptysis, lung flare-up): prompt clinician review (dataset).

concepts: NEURO-001 NEURO-002 NEURO-011 NEURO-013 GI-003 GI-008 GI-015 RENAL-003 RENAL-011
rationale: Stroke/TIA, raised intracranial pressure, swallowing problems, persistent vomiting, hepatic decompensation, recent AKI, electrolyte problems: prompt clinician review (dataset).
Recent or severe hypoglycaemia, DKA/HHS: clinician review and perioperative glycaemic plan (dataset).
New memory concern or functional decline, alcohol dependence/withdrawal, stimulant or non-prescribed opioid use: clinician review (dataset).
Declines blood products / existing treatment limits: must reach the clinician before planning (dataset RED). No specific ESC class.
Possible pregnancy, including 'unsure': changes investigation, medication and anaesthetic planning (dataset RED).

rationale: Dataset AMBER: clinician review/optimisation if positive or unresolved (communication support, stent, heart failure, pacemaker, ICD, pulmonary hypertension, cardiac admission, home oxygen, OSA, dialysis, diabetes, steroids, gastroparesis, anaemia, DVT, PE).

rationale: High-risk medicines taken (anticoagulant, antiplatelet, diabetes injections, GLP-1, SGLT2): medicine plan needed (dataset AMBER, spec ESC-004).
Awareness, severe PONV, delayed emergence, unexpected ICU admission, loose teeth (dataset AMBER).
Any known allergy, or unclear historical allergy label (dataset AMBER).
